items.title: Suspected H5 bird flu detected in Australia
items.description: A wild migratory bird in Western Australia has returned a suspected positive result for avian influenza, which has devastated populations of seabirds, seals and other animals across the world.

items.title: KMPG 'not full of bad apples', former CEO says during parliamentary grilling
items.description: Federal senators have accused senior leaders in Australia's accounting and auditing industry of behaving disgracefully as more revelations emerge about KPMG's whistleblower scandal.

items.title: 'I'm going to stay with you': Woman comes to Modra's aid moments after truck crash
items.description: Linda Cameron describes how she rendered first aid to the former Crows player and held his hand as they waited for an ambulance following a truck crash in South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula.

items.title: UK PM vows to fight for job after rival's stunning by-election win
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer's principal rival, Andy Burnham, has stormed back into parliament after a near-decade absence with a by-election win.

items.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire as US-Iran deal under strain
items.description: Fighting escalated between Israel and Hezbollah in south Lebanon overnight, with reports of more than 18 people killed in Israeli strikes and four Israeli soldiers killed.

items.title: From a White House podium, Vance delivers 'stunning development' on Israel
items.description: The US vice-president takes public aim at Israel with a series of comments Washington watchers say are "unprecedented".

items.title: Hawks break drought at Carrara, winning tough encounter against Suns
items.description: The Hawks win at Carrara for the first time since 2014, after a tough, physical encounter against the Suns.

items.title: Crucial miss sinks Dragons as Knights survive massive scare at home
items.description: The Newcastle Knights have provisionally moved into the NRL top four with a 22-20 win over the St George Illawarra Dragons. Follow live.

items.title: Australia's belief has been a long time coming. The United States are wary of it
items.description: When USA coach Mauricio Pochettino was asked about Australia's strengths ahead of the two sides' World Cup meeting in Seattle, he settled on a word — belief.

items.title: 'Astonished': Meloni hits back at Trump's claim she 'begged' him for photo
items.description: The Italian prime minister accused her one-time close ally of fabricating a story about her, after the US President told an Italian TV channel that she had "begged" him to take a photo with her at a G7 summit.

items.title: How Ukraine is breaking through defences to bring war home to Moscow
items.description: Ukraine's growing arsenal of locally produced long-range drones are getting increasingly sophisticated, allowing Kyiv to increasingly strike targets across Moscow.

items.title: 'Blue-sky thinking': North Queensland reacts to Rinehart's idea of giving islands to Musk
items.description: The Townsville Enterprise chief executive says "all ideas are welcome" after mining magnate Gina Rinehart suggested islands off North Queensland's coast should be offered to SpaceX CEO Elon Musk for satellite launches.

items.title: Man released on bail after boy injured in UK zoo crocodile enclosure
items.description: The man, who was arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a three-year-old boy ended up in a zoo's crocodile enclosure, has been released on bail after police assessed him as not fit for an interview.

items.title: Business says Labor's tax changes like a plastic surgery 'freak show'
items.description: Business has labelled Labor's proposed budget tax changes a "freak show", likening them to a celebrity who has had too much plastic surgery.

items.title: The herbs and vegetables that can grow indoors and thrive in small spaces
items.description: Even if you're short on outdoor space, there are ways to grow your own food at home. Here's what the experts recommend.

items.title: 'Miscarriage of justice' leads to retrial for parents jailed for starving daughter
items.description: The WA Court of Appeal has overturned the guilty verdicts of Perth parents who starved their daughter after ruling that the judge's conduct in the jury trial amounted to a "miscarriage of justice".

items.title: Parents in Malaysia now liable if their children bully others
items.description: Malaysia has one of the highest rates of bullying in the world and new anti-bullying laws aim to tackle the problem.

items.title: Fluke, or are the Socceroos actually good enough to win against the US?
items.description: Commentators are writing off Australia in Saturday's early morning clash against the US.  Was the Socceroos' win against Türkiye a fluke or was the way the game went part of coach Tony Popovic's plan? We take a closer look at whether Australia is being judged on the wrong metrics and why this team has fans excited.

items.title: Farmstay guest found guilty of killing host who rejected his advances
items.description: A jury has found Timothy Loosemore guilty of manslaughter over the death of Maree Vermont in Goldie, central Victoria.

items.title: Alleged 'black flight' pilot arrested at Brisbane Airport
items.description: The 32-year-old Queensland man was charged with two counts of people smuggling after a 'black flight' allegedly carried two wanted New South Wales men into Indonesia in 2025.

items.title: Superbikes move leaves Phillip Island community in limbo
items.description: The Phillip Island community is coming to terms with the loss of another major sporting event with South Australia claiming the rights to Australia's Superbike World Championship race from 2028.

items.title: The pros and cons of retiring overseas with your pension
items.description: With some foreign countries offering cheaper living expenses, it is no surprise that moving overseas to retire is increasingly attractive to some older Australians. But before you up stumps and book that flight, read this.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Soccer celebrations, bin battles, phone fails and an internet-famous duck
items.description: Today's news quiz is heating up like El Niño. Will you strut like an internet-famous duck or get schooled like Prince George?

items.title: Burnham poised to challenge UK PM Starmer after 'circus' by-election win
items.description: Andy Burnham, a British Labour lifer, is expected to challenge Sir Keir Starmer for the country's top job after re-entering the House of Commons via a by-election.

items.title: US rebuked over 'climate change' controversy at Antarctic meeting
items.description: The US has been criticised over its reluctance to refer to "climate change" at a major Antarctic meeting, with France describing it as a "dangerous precedent" that risks undermining science.
